sprint_goal: Migrate customer profile data from PostgreSQL to MongoDB with dual-write, ensuring zero downtime, data parity, and backward-compatible API performance.

tasks.title: Design MongoDB schema for flexible customer profiles
tasks.description: Model customer documents supporting country-specific fields (e.g., My Number, VAT ID). Define JSON structure, indexing strategy for common attributes, and update data contracts for internal handlers.

tasks.title: Create MongoDB index strategy
tasks.description: Identify query patterns from the current API, define compound and TTL indexes, evaluate index coverage for read latency under 50ms p95, and implement indexes on MongoDB cluster.

tasks.title: Configure CDC pipeline for PostgreSQL to MongoDB backfill
tasks.description: Set up change data capture (Debezium or AWS DMS) to sync updates from PostgreSQL to MongoDB in real-time. Include error handling and monitoring to ensure <1s lag.

tasks.title: Implement dual-write in service layer with feature flags
tasks.description: Modify backend write operations to insert/update concurrently in both PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Use feature flags to toggle dual-write mode and ensure zero downtime during rollout.

tasks.title: Validate data parity between PostgreSQL and MongoDB
tasks.description: Execute record-level parity checks using hash comparisons across 2M records. Log discrepancies, create validation reports, and ensure 100% parity before final cutover.

tasks.title: Develop rollback procedure to revert to PostgreSQL
tasks.description: Document and automate rollback steps in CI/CD pipeline to disable MongoDB writes, re-enable PostgreSQL-only mode, and restore consistent service operation within 1 hour.

tasks.title: Ensure API backward compatibility and performance validation
tasks.description: Run regression tests ensuring unchanged API contract and performance metrics. Validate read latency (<50ms p95) and identical response formats pre/post MongoDB switch.

risks.description: CDC pipeline latency exceeds 1s causing data parity delays during dual-write phase.
risks.mitigation: Monitor CDC throughput; scale connectors and tune batch processing configurations.

risks.description: Schema mismatch between PostgreSQL fields and MongoDB documents leads to data inconsistencies.
risks.mitigation: Implement schema validation scripts and enforce document mapping standards before migration.

risks.description: Unexpected performance degradation under high read/write load after cutover.
risks.mitigation: Perform load tests pre-production; tune MongoDB indexes and replica configurations proactively.

risks.description: Rollback procedure fails to revert writes during an issue, causing downtime.
risks.mitigation: Automate rollback workflow and conduct dry-run test before production rollout.

definition_of_done: CDC pipeline streaming with <1s lag verified.
Dual-write feature flag deployed and toggled successfully.
Data parity validation confirms 100% record equivalence.
API regression tests pass with identical contracts and p95 latency <50ms.
